name: microfrontend-demo
description: React Microfrontend Architecture using Webpack 5 Module Federation

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd products && npm install && cd ../cart && npm install && cd ../host && npm install && cd ..
scripts.start: concurrently -n "products,cart,host" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run start --prefix products" "npm run start --prefix cart" "npm run start --prefix host"
scripts.build:all: cd products && npm run build && cd ../cart && npm run build && cd ../host && npm run build && cd ..
